<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="ניסן_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917950_theRebbe_524" batchId="meluket-_D7_A0_D7_99_D7_A1_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917950_theRebbe_524__p007">
  <section v="18">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This drawing down is now achieved through the service of the three things, but presently it is in concealment, and in the future it will be revealed through Moshiach, connecting above and below.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this drawing down is through the service of the three things now.</t>
    <t s="1">However, now it is in concealment,</t>
    <t s="2">and in the future it will be in revelation,</t>
    <t s="3">and as explained earlier</t>
    <t s="4">(in the previous maamar63)</t>
    <t s="5">that in Moshiach there will be the connection of above and below,</t>
    <t s="6">and through him this will also be drawn down throughout the entire world,</t>
    <t s="7">that the earth will be filled with knowledge of Havayah64,</t>
    <t s="8">that even the physical earth</t>
    <t s="9">(inanimate,</t>
    <t s="10">lowest low)</t>
    <t s="11">will be filled with knowledge of Havayah</t>
    <t s="12">(highest high),</t>
    <t s="13">with the coming of Moshiach Tzidkeinu, speedily and truly.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
